name: TBBuild burnToHolder values burned PDZ at the pair's spot price
summary: TBBuild.burnToHolder(amount, inviter) values the burned PDZ with PancakeRouter.getAmountsOut against the live PDZ/WBNB pair, has PDZ.burnToholder forward that many BNB from the PDZ token's balance to TBBuild when it holds enough, and credits the caller TB reward tokens worth the same value, which receiveRewards pays out in BNB from TBBuild's balance. In the anchor, contract 0x782842a0 flash-borrowed 4 WBNB, bought the PDZ/WBNB pair 0x7b51150f nearly empty of PDZ, burned 3,426,626 wei of PDZ valued at 3.876 BNB (paid from PDZ into TBBuild), claimed 1.222 BNB with receiveRewards, sold the PDZ back and repaid. In August 2025 the DeFiHackLabs attacker repeated it with 10 WBNB for 3.606 BNB, followed by three copycats.
notes: Anchor: campaign.mjs over TBBuild 0x66420157's burnToHolder and receiveRewards calls from deployment to block 58000000 finds 98 earlier exercises, all direct EOA burns and claims during the January 2024 launch (largest payouts 1.997 BNB to 0xed773087 and 1.282 BNB to 0x1b6b5a56, claimed days after ordinary burns, with no price manipulation in the transaction). The first flash-loan manipulation is 0x88f8741d (2025-01-26) by EOA 0xfae5364d through contract 0x782842a0, created 92 blocks earlier; the reported DeFiHackLabs transaction 0x81fd00ea (2025-08-16) is a repeat, followed within hours by 0x770624c0 (0x0cb7a78f reusing that attacker's contract 0x81f1acd2), 0xcede3d23 and 0xbb824eca (0x559e1ce8). No later TBBuild payouts exist.

Reset: PDZ's launch flag (slot 0xe), first set at block 35576215 (0xc81534b0), when the 600th airdrop payment made the airdrop contract call setLaunch(true). PDZ.burnToholder and every PDZ transfer between non-excluded accounts require it, so it first made the exploited path usable (rule 8). Before it, TBBuild was deployed in 0x88c4abe5 (block 35561502) with PDZ as its burn token, and 24 blocks later the PDZ owner made TBBuild PDZ's burnHolder (slot 0x9), which burnToHolder requires, with setBurnHolder in 0x8c9bd8cc. Other later changes are balances. The earlier PDZ deployment 0xdf32f2e7 by the same deployer was never used.

Loss is the BNB that left PDZ 0x50f2b2a5 and TBBuild together per transaction (loss.mjs --victims both): 1.222 BNB in the anchor, where PDZ paid 3.876 BNB into TBBuild and TBBuild paid 1.222 BNB out, 3.606 BNB in 0x81fd00ea and 0.182 BNB across the copycats. The flash loans were repaid in the same transactions; the PDZ/WBNB pair only round-tripped the attackers' WBNB.
